## Names

<a id="joy_rotate_bits"></a>
### [`joy_rotate_bits`](../../../src/room_tables.asm#L8) `$4A85-$4A88`

*data*

Joystick rotation for the left-handed mode of frame_update (joystick_right_handed = 0): new = (joy >> 2) OR joy_rotate_bits[joy AND 3]. CIA bits 0-3 = up, down, left, right, 0 = pressed. Result: up -> right, down -> left, left -> up, right -> down.

- **Referred to by:** [`frame_update`](frame_update.md#frame_update) [`$16BA`](../../../src/frame_update.asm#L199), [`frame_update`](frame_update.md#frame_update) [`$16F1`](../../../src/frame_update.asm#L234)

<a id="wizard_face_zone_x"></a>
### [`wizard_face_zone_x`](../../../src/room_tables.asm#L13) `$4A89-$4A8B`

*data*

Room 18: Bruce X (actor_x) limits of the wizard face zones. room18_frame compares with entries 2 and 1 ($76, $3A): X >= $76 -> zone 2, X >= $3A -> zone 1, else zone 0 (entry 0 is not compared). The zone selects the face messages $38+zone, $3B+zone and $3E+zone.

- **Read by:** [`room18_frame`](wizard_room.md#room18_frame) [`$3D46`](../../../src/wizard_room.asm#L68) (+1), [`room18_frame`](wizard_room.md#room18_frame) [`$3D46`](../../../src/wizard_room.asm#L68) (+2)

<a id="actor_state_step_delay"></a>
### [`actor_state_step_delay`](../../../src/room_tables.asm#L19) `$4A8C-$4AA7`

*data*

Step delay of each actor state: 28 bytes indexed by the state number (actor_state). The state setters (actor_set_state, actor_set_state_timer15, actor_set_state_timer12, actor_continue_state and the hit state setter) copy the entry to actor_step_delay,x; actor_action_step skips that many main loop passes before the next step of the actor.

<a id="room_map_ptr_lo"></a>
### [`room_map_ptr_lo`](../../../src/room_tables.asm#L69) `$4B34-$4B48`

*data*

Room map addresses, low bytes then high bytes (21 entries: rooms 0-19 and the end of the last map $7FE0). draw_room reads the map of the current room. Map format: a byte with bit 7 clear is a run: count = byte, then one cell code drawn count times; a byte with bit 7 set is a literal block: count = byte AND $7F (0 = end of map) cell codes follow. Each cell is a double-height char: code on the top row, code OR $80 on the row below (codes with bit 7 set also go through map_tile_set_black). 40 cells per row pair (room_draw_step_cell).

- **Referred to by:** [`draw_room`](draw_room.md#draw_room) [`$0AAF`](../../../src/draw_room.asm#L159)

<a id="exit2_dest_room"></a>
### [`exit2_dest_room`](../../../src/room_tables.asm#L78) `$4B5E-$4B71`

*data*

Exit table entries with no exit marker in the room map and none drawn by the room code (so never used): room 3 marker 5, room 6 markers 3, 4 and 5, room 7 markers 2 and 5. Markers drawn later by room code: room 1/3 trapdoor (marker 3, msg_trapdoor_open_*), room 2 floor (marker 5, msg_room2_gap_top), room 5 left edge (marker 2, msg_room5_gap_edge) and top (marker 5, msg_room5_opening), room 9 top (marker 4, msg_room9_opening), room 15 right edge (marker 3, msg_room15_ladder_mid/top), room 18 right exit (marker 3, msg_wizard_exit_top). Room 11 has three door markers 3/4/5 on row 7 (check_exit_edge always allows them).

- **Written by:** [`game_over`](lose_fall_game_over.md#game_over) [`$190C`](../../../src/lose_fall_game_over.asm#L146) (+12)
- **Referred to by:** [`take_exit2`](background_touch.md#take_exit2) [`$2F43`](../../../src/background_touch.asm#L183)

<a id="room_no_enemies"></a>
### [`room_no_enemies`](../../../src/room_tables.asm#L164) `$4C9E-$4CB1`

*data*

Per-room flag (20 bytes): $FF = no enemies. draw_room copies it to room_no_enemy_flag; while it is nonzero the enemy updates (tick_spawn_timers, update_yamo_spawn, update_ninja_spawn) and the sprite-sprite collision test (check_fight_collisions) are skipped, and frame_update skips its Yamo idle code. Set for rooms 3, 8, 9, 11, 13, 17, 18 and 19.

- **Referred to by:** [`draw_room`](draw_room.md#draw_room) [`$0A41`](../../../src/draw_room.asm#L95), [`main_loop`](game_main_loop.md#main_loop) [`$1C1E`](../../../src/game_main_loop.asm#L74)
